says: The p33 real isolation law's inline sealed program declares its Msg as Schema.Struct({type: Schema.Literal('read')}), so under decision 0569 the stepper refuses every Msg it is sent, `{ type: "read" }` and `{ _tag: "read" }` alike, and the law's 'read until the program's own fetch settles' loop at line 829 can never advance: in every green run that loop is never entered, and whenever the fetch has not settled when init returns, the step answers refused and the SealedTurn decode fails the law.
proof: From next/apps/fabrika, `node --input-type=module -e` building the same machine and program object with Machine.make and calling stepper(program) from @kampus/libfabrika printed `init {"_tag":"stepped","model":{"keys":[],"outbound":"pending"},...}`, then `type {"_tag":"refused","reason":"bad_msg"}` and `_tag {"_tag":"refused","reason":"bad_msg"}`. The loaded box serves step through the same stepper (next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/box.ts line 40, runtime/Execution.ts line 260), and `turn` (instance-one-file.integration.test.ts line 225) decodes the answer as SealedTurn, a `stepped` TaggedStruct (line 208).
cost: The wait the law's comment promises does not exist, so on a slow runner the law fails instead of waiting, which may feed the timeout and flake its lead row 2026-11-18-p33-isolation-times-out-under-load names, and the type-keyed Msg stays in the tree for an agent to copy (0562).
